Jordan: Heads-up: reproduced a perf regression on multi-GPU fused-attn + tensor/pipeline split when sharding QKV across 3 ranks. End-to-end p95 latency up ~22% for seq=2048.
Priya: Can you paste the perf profile or nvprof trace?
Jordan: Quick nvprof snippet (trimmed):
```
Kernel: fused_attn       9.1ms
Kernel: attn_fallback   28.7ms
Memcpy DtoD: reorder    65.2ms
NCCL AllGather         42.3ms
Idle wait (CPU)        12.4ms
```
Ethan: Looks like QKV path does an extra device memcpy+reorder before allgather. Why are we reordering?
Jordan: Kernel selector currently requires contiguous heads-per-rank to pick flash kernel. With a 3-way tensor split head stride is non-contig -> selector falls back to generic attn_fallback. But runtime still issues a qkv_allgather assuming contiguous layout, so we end up memcpy->reorder->allgather->fallback kernel.
Kai: Also seeing NCCL stalls. Allreduce/allgather overlap with compute is poor: lots of small frequent collectives due to our batching heuristic flushing early. Micro-batches are causing comm to be latency-bound.
Priya: Batching config note: continuous batching groups requests but flush threshold triggers when seq-length variance high. For short-tail-heavy workloads that forces many partial KV pushes.
Jordan: Repro command: `./tools/run_tp_bench --model=gptx --tp=3 --seq=2048 --bs=4 --profile=nvprof --kernelselect=auto`
Ethan: Proposal: change kernelpicker to detect strided QKV layouts and either (a) prelayout contiguous QKV per rank before kernel decision, or (b) implement a fused-attn path that accepts strided inputs and does internal gather without extra D2D memcpy.
Kai: (a) might be easier: prelayout into pinned host mem staging then upload as single contiguous buffer to GPU to avoid device memcpy storms. But pinned staging adds memory pressure.
Priya: Could we instead move the reorder earlier at model dispatch so QKV are produced contiguous per TP partition? That avoids extra memcpy entirely.
Jordan: I tried prelayout in a quick branch: memcpy time dropped ~60ms, overall latency improved ~14%, memory use +6%. Patch: `prefetch_qkv_contig=true` in kernelpicker.
Ethan: Watch out for odd-head-count corner cases; flash-attn falls back when heads%warp != 0. Add unit tests for heads=7 with tp=3 split.
Kai: I'll run HW matrix (A100 NVLink vs DGX) to see topology effect. If NVLink topology is partial, NCCL ring might not overlap well and amplify allgather cost.
Jordan: Filed INF-2379 with nvprof traces and microbench scripts. I'll open a PR with the benchmark and failing test.
Priya: :thumbsup: please tag @eng-runtime and add perf regression numbers in the PR description.
perf-bot: perf-job started for INF-2379 on build-20260318-rc3.
deploy-bot: CI scheduled for branch/jordan/qkv-prelayout.
Ethan: Another angle: make our allgather path stride-aware by using NCCL with strided pointers or implement a custom peer-to-peer gather for this pattern. NCCL doesn't expose a stride param but we could implement ring gather kernels.
Jordan: For immediate mitigation I'll add the prelayout heuristic behind a flag and a perf test. Longer term: kernelpicker should reason about both layout and comm cost to avoid these reorder+fallback combos.
Kai: Thanks — I'll share HW runs in the thread once done.
Jordan: Thanks all, will follow up with PR and perf artifacts.
